query:
The group decided to do the High Crag circular route. What did Marcus's response to that decision signal about his actual position, and what specifically in how he responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Tomas
B. Bridget
C. Marcus
D. Elena
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:03:00) High Crag circular is a loop. I'd rather do the out-and-back via the eastern approach -- there's a proper summit. Same hill, better finish.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:14:00) Fine. Circular it is. I'll send the route sheet. Confirm by Thursday.
[3] (about=Bridget, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:04:00) The circular has a clear finish at the car park. That is an end point.
[4] (about=Bridget, episodic, t3 @2025-10-05T15:01:00) Next week I can plan if Marcus wants a week off the logistics. I've done the High Crag circular before -- it's well-signed, no surprises.
[5] (about=Tomas, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:10:00) The eastern spur timed section is brilliant -- 1.2km of clean path, measurable against prior attempts. I'd vote circular for that reason alone. Who else? 😄
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t4 @2025-10-05T15:45:00) Next week's hike is the High Crag circular route, chosen over the out-and-back eastern approach; Marcus will send the route sheet and confirmations are due by Thursday.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t20 @2025-11-30T14:32:00) Spring route plan should include at least one genuinely steep descent, not just moderately steep.
[8] (about=Marcus, core, t18 @2025-11-23T15:47:00) States the approach to the second col is the steepest terrain they'll have done, 820m total over two days, a serious outing by local standards.
[9] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2025-10-26T14:47:00) Will handle the technical route for Cairn Ridge, including the north face approach.
agent_answer:
Marcus's response signaled he actually preferred the **out-and-back via the eastern approach**, not the circular route. His earlier statement made that explicit: *"I'd rather do the out-and-back... there's a proper summit. Same hill, better finish."* Then, when the group decided on the circular, he agreed only with **"Fine. Circular it is."** — that resigned "Fine" shows reluctant acceptance of the group decision, not a genuine change of preference.

So the person in the options is **C. Marcus**.

query:
The group settled on going to the Green Man at 6pm for the end-of-year dinner. What did Marcus's response to that moment reveal about how he actually felt, and how would you have known?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Tomas
C. Nadia
D. Kwame
context:
[1] (about=Elena, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:14:00) form check: done. you're a different hiker to the one who joined us 😊 also for end of year -- Green Man tonight? I've already messaged them. table for nine at 6pm.
[2] (about=Tomas, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:18:00) Green Man at 6pm -- proper end of year. I've been doing a mental inventory of the routes we've covered since September and I think we've done something like 5,000m of cumulative gain. That's a serious season for a group that started with Kestrel Ridge in September and a debate about whether 480m was too much. Back in the day I would not have believed we'd be planning three-night overnights by December. Anyway -- what a year. Who else is counting down to spring? 😄🏔️
[3] (about=Kwame, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:28:00) I'm pitching the spring three-nighter to the podcast as the season finale episode. Nadia and Dmitri co-planning it basically writes itself. with their permission obviously 😊 anyway Green Man at 6 -- I'll be there on time. I know you're all shocked 🎉
[4] (about=Tomas, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:34:00) And she navigated the Stoneford col approach using a paper map because her phone died and did it correctly. Back in the day I would have said that takes years to learn. Apparently it takes one season and good people around you. Anyway -- 6pm, Green Man. See you all there. 🏔️😄
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:38:00) Good season. See everyone at six.
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:04:00) Good trip. Route held together, logistics were clean, no incidents. Nadia, that was an excellent piece of planning. The bothy capacity and the weather window aligned well.
[7] (about=Bridget, episodic, t22 @2025-12-07T16:16:00) Final cost reconciliation for the bothy trip:
- Bothy contribution: 5.00pp settled
- Transport: 7.20pp average settled
- Total: 12.20pp
All square. Green Man confirmed from me for tonight.
[8] (about=Tomas, episodic, t2 @2025-09-28T15:05:00) There's a pub about 10 minutes further on -- the Green Man -- that does proper food and has stair access, I've been before. Might be better for tired legs. Anyone else thinking the same? 🍺
[9] (about=Elena, episodic, t6 @2025-10-12T14:25:00) Green Man worked well last week by the way -- everyone got fed, could hear each other. Booking it again for next Sunday if that's alright? 🍺
[10] (about=Elena, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T15:47:00) yeah it was rough 😬 I've already looked up the Green Man for next week. It does food, good stair access, quieter on Sundays. I'll book a table for the group -- anyone with dietary stuff let me know by Friday.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Elena, group-interaction, t4 @2025-10-05T15:45:00) Next week's post-hike debrief will be at the Green Man pub; Elena will book a table and asks for dietary requirements by Friday.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Elena, group-interaction, t6 @2025-10-12T14:02:00) Green Man pub booked again for next Sunday's post-hike debrief; it worked well last week.
agent_answer: Marcus’s response revealed that he felt **underwhelmed or indifferent** about the end-of-year dinner. You would know because his reply was extremely brief and flat — just “Good season. See everyone at six.” — with none of the enthusiasm, nostalgia, or excitement that Tomas and Kwame showed. So the answer is **A. Marcus**.
